Interesting facts
The paint appeared on May 6th, 2013.
It had a protection of 15% from all turrets.
The paint was distributed to winners of the May Holidays 2013 edition of «The GAME»
Only 9636 players obtained the paint at the time.
The paint was removed from the game a week after the event concluded.
The paint has no connection to the regular garage paint Storm
